retain_full_lhs.mechanism: checked full-K LHS retention for multi-M-tile blocks
retain_full_lhs.note: Raw i32 or scalar native i8, no bias; original-view capacity and repeated-load guards; other classes preserve the incumbent.

pipeline_max_m_blocks.mechanism: checked dense K=1 capacity-limited M block alternative
pipeline_max_m_blocks.note: Incumbent8; opt-in16 reuses the selected ACC/operand capacity checks and per-K drains. No shape class promoted.

conv_operand_cache.mechanism: source-exact rolling blocked operand row reuse
conv_operand_cache.note: Uses general program/storage predicates; missing premises retain the prior valid route.

conv_resident_compute_epochs.note: Uses general program/storage predicates; missing premises retain the prior valid route.

conv_coalesced_rhs_preparation.mechanism: disjoint resident RHS transfer coalescing and preparation completion
conv_coalesced_rhs_preparation.note: Uses general program/storage predicates; missing premises retain the prior valid route.

conv_spatial_accumulation.note: Interleave independent spatial tiles through full reduction; retain every output and drain before readout.

conv_persistent_zero_bands.mechanism: initialize disjoint physical padding bands once per invocation
conv_persistent_zero_bands.note: Source and disjoint storage predicates; no changed output/readout semantics.

conv_zero_row_elision.mechanism: eliminate exact additive-zero padding rows after original bias initialization
conv_zero_row_elision.note: Source and disjoint storage predicates; no changed output/readout semantics.

conv_readout_batch.mechanism: complete disjoint constant-configuration readout batch before accumulator reuse
conv_readout_batch.note: Only equal f32 readout scales and fixed activation; all stores retained and final batch drain is mandatory.
